title: The affine derived unit induces isomorphisms on cohomology
statement: In the setting of the affine derived unit theorem, for every derived A-module M and every integer n, the map on degree-n homology induced by adj.unit.app M is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Prove exactness of tilde by lifting the quasi-coherent kernel of tilde(f) through its invertible ordinary counit. Full faithfulness reflects the lifted limit fork. The left adjoint also preserves colimits and biproducts, hence is additive and exact.

Construct the canonical unbounded adjunction of exact tilde with right-derived affine sections using mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction. On Qh(K), derivedη_fac_app factors its unit, followed by the exact-functor comparison, as Qh of the ordinary homotopy unit followed by the sections comparison. The ordinary homotopy unit is invertible by full faithfulness, and the sections comparison is invertible by new-affine-tilde-derived-sections-unit-isIso. Cancel the exact-functor comparison. Essential surjectivity of Qh and naturality give invertibility at every derived module.

Descend hF through Q with Localization.liftNatIso. Restrict the canonical adjunction along identity and the fully faithful inclusion of D_QCoh using this descended comparison and hG. The restriction unit formula expresses its unit as the canonical unit followed by isomorphisms. Uniqueness of right adjoints expresses the unit of adj as that unit followed by a natural isomorphism. Finally homology preserves isomorphisms.
